No TV in bed. If you're awake more than 20 minutes at night, get up, read in another room, and return to bed when drowsy. Limit naps to 20 minutes max before 2:00 PM. Have your last coffee by noon. Follow up in 6 weeks, or sooner if you feel confused or have a fall.
